description: When the user does not exist in GitLab, it is created.

parameters.name: access_level
parameters.description: The access level to the group. The value master is an alias for maintainer. Choices: "guest" ← (default) "reporter" "developer" "master" "maintainer" "owner"

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Require confirmation. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email that belongs to the user. Required only if state=present.

parameters.name: external
parameters.description: Define external parameter for this user. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: ID or Full path of parent group in the form of group/name. Add user as a member to this group.

parameters.name: identities
parameters.description: List of identities to be added/updated for this user. To remove all other identities from this user, set overwrite_identities=true.

parameters.name: extern_uid
parameters.description: User ID for external identity.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The name of the external identity provider.

parameters.name: isadmin
parameters.description: Grant admin privileges to the user. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the user you want to create. Required only if state=present.

parameters.name: overwrite_identities
parameters.description: Overwrite identities with identities added in this module. This means that all identities that the user has and that are not listed in identities are removed from the user. This is only done if a list is provided for identities. To remove all identities, provide an empty list. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password of the user. GitLab server enforces minimum password length to 8, set this value with 8 or more characters.

parameters.name: reset_password
parameters.description: Whether the user can change its password or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: sshkey_expires_at
parameters.description: The expiration date of the SSH public key in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. This is only used when adding new SSH public keys.

parameters.name: sshkey_file
parameters.description: The SSH public key itself.

parameters.name: sshkey_name
parameters.description: The name of the SSH public key.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create, delete or block a user. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "blocked" "unblocked"

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username of the user.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: "Delete GitLab User"
  community.general.gitlab_user:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    username: myusername
    state: absent

- name: "Create GitLab User"
  community.general.gitlab_user:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    validate_certs: true
    api_username: dj-wasabi
    api_password: "MySecretPassword"
    name: My Name
    username: myusername
    password: mysecretpassword
    email: me@example.com
    sshkey_name: MySSH
    sshkey_file: ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc...
    state: present
    group: super_group/mon_group
    access_level: owner

- name: "Create GitLab User using external identity provider"
  community.general.gitlab_user:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    validate_certs: true
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    name: My Name
    username: myusername
    password: mysecretpassword
    email: me@example.com
    identities:
      - provider: Keycloak
        extern_uid: f278f95c-12c7-4d51-996f-758cc2eb11bc
    state: present
    group: super_group/mon_group
    access_level: owner

- name: "Block GitLab User"
  community.general.gitlab_user:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    username: myusername
    state: blocked

- name: "Unblock GitLab User"
  community.general.gitlab_user:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    username: myusername
    state: unblocked

return_values.name: error
return_values.description: The error message returned by the GitLab API. Returned: failed Sample: "400: path is already in use"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Success or failure message. Returned: always Sample: "Success"

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: JSON-parsed response from the server. Returned: always
